method: Read-only source and saved evidence diagnosis; no product changes, new tasks, GUI, model invocation or mutation. Exact DB projection was independently performed by computer_correctness.

observed.nativeStopCheck: Initially CANCELLING, local failed/stop surface retained and no late success during approximately 11 seconds.
observed.laterTask: FAILED at 2026-10-01T23:15:42.198Z; error activity StartToClose timeout
observed.hostRequest: llm.answer PENDING since 23:10:42.158Z; claimed_at/completed_at/error null, no result; expiry 23:25:42.158Z

finding.summary: Accepted cancellation does not settle a pending host wait; subsequent ordinary-step failure overwrites cancellation with FAILED.

chain.fact: Cancel commits tasks.status=CANCELLING and sends a workflow signal.
Signal only sets cancelRequested; it does not cancel the in-flight activity await.
claimNext excludes CANCELLING/terminal tasks; the observed PENDING request therefore cannot start after Stop.
Wait loop sees only request DONE/FAILED, not task cancellation; default wait is 10 minutes. No observed claimant will terminalize this request.
General metered step has a five-minute single-attempt StartToClose timeout. Ordinary catch calls failWith without preserving cancellation.
Without explicit preserveCancellation, failTask changes CANCELLING to FAILED even under the row lock.

scopeAndLimits: The durable unclaimed host row supports no model execution for this exact host request; it is not proof about every other task or process.

No indication of an infinite model/resource leak for this task. The source can retain a database polling wait beyond workflow finalization until its own bounded wait ends; actual residual timer lifetime was not measured.
The existing transaction cancellation/unknown-result preservation is a separate patched path and must be retained.
Prior native aistop PASS establishes prompt stop receipt and stable local presentation only; it did not establish terminal CANCELLED.
No successful external operation cancellation is asserted.
minimalFixRecommendation: Settle or terminate the pending host wait promptly when the owning task no longer permits execution, using a typed cancellation outcome and preserving claimed-request result/unknown semantics. Any PENDING settlement must be conditional and safe against a simultaneous claim.

Use replay-compatible workflow handling and atomic persistence to preserve an accepted Stop when ordinary step errors/timeouts race its signal; never replace an already committed terminal success or erase transaction unknown evidence.

Add pending-before-claim, claimed-race, cancellation-plus-late-error, and replay regressions. Strengthen the real aistop test to require a bounded terminal cancellation, while retaining its late-success UI check. Do not label CANCELLING as terminal success.
